groups.title: Question 15-20.
groups.instruction: Complete the map below with A-I.

transcript.text: Now listen and answer a questions 15 to 20.
So, let me give you each a plan of the spa to help you find your way around.
So at present, we're in the circular entrance hall, at the bottom of the map with a street behind us.
So if you want to find the main pool, well, that's outside, so you go right down the corridor from the main entrance, then out into the garden.
You'll see tables out there to your right by the cafe. The pools on your left can't be hidden by the trees. It's a lovely setting.
One thing I must mention that you wouldn't expect, there's a stone chessboard in the garden. There is stone chessmen there too, and you can sit and play.
It's just past the terrace, right in the far corner of the garden. It's a beautiful quiet spot.

If you find you need something like sunscreen, there's a spa shop in the main building. The door opens directly off the entrance hall, and you can get most things there, even postcards. It's open until 5 o'clock.
If you're looking for somewhere to sit and have a snack, we have a picnic area. It's out in the garden, and it's quite secluded.
It's by the fountain at the back of the garden, on the far side of the terrace. It should be lovely there today in the sunshine.

Then if you're heading off a treatment or a massage, the treatment rooms are all down the corridor. That's not the corridor to the garden, but the one that goes straight from the entrance hall past the fitness room.
The door to the treatment rooms is at the end of that corridor.
One final thing, we do ask you to take a shower if you're going to be using any of the facilities.
To get to the shower rooms, walk in the direction of the garden, but before you get there, turn right. They're down there, opposite the changing rooms.
That is the end of section 2. You now have half a minute to check your answers.
